title: Tour de France
metaDescription: Tour de France 2027 starts with a Great Britain Grand Départ from Edinburgh on 2 July 2027.

overview.about: The Tour de France is the world's greatest cycling race - a three-week, roughly 3,400 km test of endurance around France and its neighbours every July, decided in the high mountains of the Alps and Pyrenees. The rider in the yellow jersey after 21 stages is the champion. Four riders share the record of five overall wins. The 2027 race runs 2-25 July, opening with a Grand Depart in Edinburgh.
overview.nextEvent: The 2027 Tour de France runs 2-25 July, with a Grand Depart in Edinburgh, Scotland before the race heads to France. Over 21 stages and two rest days, riders cover flat sprints, brutal mountain days and time trials before the finish in Paris.
